preservation_policy: Original artifacts and prior result records are retained. This record explicitly supersedes only their execution-host interpretation, not their observed Official metrics.

postsession_qualification.state_transport: Replay checkout is synchronized back to Mac after remote execution.
postsession_qualification.position_2: Not reached because static candidate validation terminated generation.

official_evaluation.docker_selection: The EnvBench adapter invokes Docker through the Mac process environment and has no remote-execution transport.
official_evaluation.positions_1_and_3_context: not recorded; the code path used the then-current Mac Docker context

agenthub.current_capacity: 14 CPU, 96 GB RAM, Docker available, approximately 5 GiB free disk
agenthub.activation_blocker: Insufficient free disk for reliable case execution

program_handoff.mechanism: The normalized submitted script is written to scripts/generated.sh, copied byte-for-byte to scripts/bootstrap.sh, serialized in inputs/evaluator.jsonl, then executed by EnvBench with input.use_scripts=true.

position_4_identity.hash_semantics: Qualification records hash canonical text without a terminal LF; serialized script files include one terminal LF.

causal_differences: Spark and Mac Docker use different network egress paths; a replay success on Spark does not rule out an Official network failure on Mac.
Spark source acquisition uses an exact-revision cache, while Official evaluation records no equivalent repository acquisition cache.
Docker package and image caches are host-local even though the EnvBench image digest and architecture match.
Spark exposes the NVIDIA GB10 to construction and replay; Mac Official does not expose that accelerator.
Both container backends are linux-aarch64 with the same image digest, reducing but not eliminating environment differences.

incorrect_or_incomplete_existing_claims.correction: Official was launched by the Mac-local evaluator; its exact historical Docker context was not recorded.
